scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && firebase deploy -P prod
scripts.deploy:test: npm run build:test && firebase deploy -P test
scripts.deploy:test:hosting: npm run build:test && firebase deploy -P test --only hosting
scripts.seed:test: npx -y firebase-tools@15 emulators:exec --project test --only functions "node functions/scripts/seed-test-env.mjs"
scripts.seed:test:apply: npx -y firebase-tools@15 emulators:exec --project test --only functions "node functions/scripts/seed-test-env.mjs --apply"
scripts.test:emulator: npx -y firebase-tools@15 emulators:exec --project prod --only functions,firestore "node functions/scripts/test-pricing.mjs"
